hypothesis: The gravity structure linearly decodable from attention heads is used by next-step prediction, not just readable from it. At m2 fixed and e in [0, 0.7], replacing the output of the attention head that best encodes force with its output on a different system clearly degrades prediction, while doing the same to the lowest-scoring control head does not.
expected_if_true: In both seeds, the top force-scoring head has patching effect (patched_mse/clean_mse - 1) >= 0.5 and at least 3x the control head's effect. At the same time, force and accel_step probes beat control by >= the required margin, as in seeds 24 and 26.
expected_if_false: In at least one seed, the top force-scoring head has patching effect < 0.2 or within 2x of the control head's effect. That would mean the force-like head signal is decodable but carries little that prediction depends on.
